svg.title: A failed install gets a bounded retry.
svg.desc: A: install Chromium using hosted Ubuntu libraries. B: retry failures up to three attempts, waiting 15 then 30 seconds; persistent failure stops the build. C: successful installation proceeds to tests and distribution checks before PyPI publishing.
svg.text: A failed install gets a bounded retry.
GitHub Actions / browser setup → checked package
Still failing / timed out → stop; no publish
Failed builds leave existing PyPI files unchanged.
